messages:
maria: Hey team — customer acct=54321 can't start their free trial. They applied promo SPRING50 but the checkout asks for card and the 3DS/ACS flow gets stuck in a redirect loop. Payment gateway returned: HTTP 402 {"error":"preauth_required","detail":"ACS redirect loop - ACS_JUST_REDIRECTED"}. Can someone triage?

alex: Can you paste the exact request/response and region/card last4? Short repro steps please.

maria: UK customer, last4=4242. Repro curl (redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/payment_methods \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"card_number":"********4242","exp":"08/27","billing_country":"GB","return_url":"https://console.redwood.ai/support/3ds-callback"}'
```
Response sequence: 302 Found -> Location: https://acs.issuer.example/auth?PaReq=... then 302 -> https://acs.issuer.example/iframe then 302 back to issuer endpoint, repeat. Our payment_gateway logs: payment_gateway:3ds_status=\"acs_redirect_loop\" code=ACM-302.

payments_eng: @maria thanks. Do we see repeated webhook events (3ds_challenge / issuer_redirect)? Any browser console errors (CSP / X-Frame-Options)?

maria: Webhook shows three issuer_redirect events within ~12s. Browser console logged: \"Refused to display 'https://acs.issuer.example/' in a frame because it set 'X-Frame-Options' to 'sameorigin'\".

jordan: That matches an issuer that blocks framing. Our default flow tries an iframe embed for ACS which fails if the issuer sets X-Frame-Options. Gateway should fall back to top-level redirect but in this region/account it looks like routing used the iframe path.

jordan: Quick mitigation: I can enable top-level redirect fallback for acct=54321 so the customer gets a regular redirect to ACS (avoids frame bust). After that we can manual-grant the trial if the preauth still doesn't complete.

maria: Can you flip it now? Customer is in an onboarding call.

jordan: Done — routing_override=true for acct=54321. Also manual grant command for support console: `support-admin grant_trial --account=54321 --promo=SPRING50 --notes=\"3DS ACS loop, manual grant\"` (this writes an audit entry).

billing-bot: Automated note: promo_applied=true preauth_status=required action=manual_grant account=54321

alex: Customer confirmed checkout completed and card token created after override. Trial granted manually. :white_check_mark:

maria: Filing follow-up: added short incident in #incidents with repro, browser console snippet, and recommended fix to prefer top-level redirect for GB issuers when X-Frame-Options present. Also added a card to eng-payments backlog to update gateway routing rules. Thanks everyone.
